question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

Out of those group members, Rohan is the __one who opposes others__, no matter what they tell him.
solution:
The correct answer is '**antagonist**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**antagonist**" refers to a person who actively opposes or is hostile to someone or something. (विरोधी)
 
• Rohan is described as someone who opposes others in the group, making him an antagonist.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Out of those group members, Rohan is the one who opposes others, no matter what they tell him. He is an antagonist__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Agonist (प्रतिपक्षी)**: means a person who is engaged in a contest, conflict, or struggle.
 
• **Anatomist (शरीररचना विज्ञानी)**: means a person who studies anatomy.
 
• **Protagonist (मुख्य पात्र)**: means the leading character or one of the major characters in a drama, movie, novel, or other fictional text.
